facts.anchor: Lucy stumbles backwards, turns, and runs.
facts.fact: 听到警报，Lucy 想起烤箱里的 cornbread，踉跄后退、转身跑回自己公寓。

facts.anchor: Saskia puts her hand on the oven to prevent Lucy from opening it
facts.fact: Saskia 随后赶到，用手挡住烤箱门阻止 Lucy 打开，并按下 OFF 键，警告开门会冒出更多烟甚至起火。

facts.anchor: “Do you have a—a girlfriend?” Lucy asks suddenly
facts.fact: Lucy 突然问 Saskia 是否有女朋友、是否因此戴面具；Saskia 摇头答 “Nope.”。

facts.anchor: There is absolutely nothing wrong with you. I just don’t want to hurt you.
facts.fact: Saskia 从背后抱住 Lucy，说 Lucy 绝对没有问题，“I just don’t want to hurt you”。

facts.anchor: something boiling hot splatters across her back
facts.fact: 锅中沸汤溅到 Lucy 背上烫伤；Saskia 查看后说 “See? Someone gets hurt.”。

facts.anchor: Roger standing in the door to her bedroom
facts.fact: Roger 因火警警报只身进入 Lucy 公寓，站在她卧室门口，看到正在换衣服的 Lucy。

facts.anchor: his eyes land on the socket that once held his camera
facts.fact: Roger 发现曾装着他摄像头（他谎称是充电器）的插座空着，质问 Lucy 是否动了他的东西；Lucy 佯装无辜，在白板写下加租 10 美元赔偿。

facts.anchor: Oh—because Saskia left the door open.
facts.fact: Roger 走后，Lucy 意识到是 Saskia 没关门，并疑惑 Saskia 去了哪里。
